usedFor: AutoQuote3D produces quotes and orders for a 3D print shop; HubSpot holds the customers. A “New Quote” in AutoQuote3D can run “Create Deal” so each quote is tracked in the pipeline.

bestTemplate.name: “New Quote” in AutoQuote3D, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A quote is an open sales opportunity, so a deal lets you follow up before it goes cold. “New Order” can update the contact.

watchOut: “New Quote” and “New Order” are polling, so HubSpot updates after the next check. “Update Contact” finds the person by email.
